div.head: ECf 12.11
div.ab:
Similiter de aquis minoribus, naues ferentibus cum eis que necessaria sunt ciuitatibus et burgis,
scilicet ligna et cetera: cum lege minorum chiminorum sit et emendatio earum.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 639–640 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.
Liebermann’s upright (roman) letter a after “lege” refers to his explanatory notes, the Erklärungen (printed as Gesetze III; his note on p. 627 calls it “Band II”), which are not yet added here.
Liebermann’s letter after “lege” may be his upright a (the Erklärungen) or his footnote a; both are noted here.

div.ab: Likewise concerning the lesser waters, which carry ships with the things which are necessary for cities and boroughs, namely wood and the like: let their compensation also be with the law of the lesser highways.
